findings.consequence: The acceptance gate does not prove that an independent reviewer approved this review.json; a status-only approval can pass without binding to the review evidence. Require reviewer identity/role and review path plus SHA-256, and verify that binding before acceptance.
findings.trigger: Approval JSON has the expected status, zero remaining findings, matching repair-plan SHA, and self-consistent supplied pins, but names no reviewer or review artifact.

limits: Static review only; did not invoke the saved auditor or modify shared state or lease.
Did not read comparison.json, group episode outcomes, or any performance values.
Hash pins establish current file identity only; review does not establish live runtime acceptance or continuous cache-path absence.
Existing test_repair.py was inspected but not run.
review_scope: Read-only static review of saved repair sources and frozen metadata. No evaluation rerun, auditor invocation, performance inspection, comparison.json read, or outcome inspection.
verified: Repair-plan SHA matches the requested pin; every plan pin currently matches its saved file.
Successor auditor equals the explicit reviewed source delta from the preserved original auditor.
Only cache disposition changed in the auditor; original non-cache process, output, resource, audit, and lease checks remain.
Cache exception uses lexists and rejects every existing path state; bytecode policy still requires dont_write_bytecode and the registered pycache_prefix.
Registration, envelope, source, runtime, and output checks remain bound through original pinned validation; output contents were not opened.
Acceptance record is durably saved before exact lease-key mutation; lease release receipt is saved afterward.
